# Home Environment Manager v0.6.0b13 — One climate-device picker per room

This opt-in beta corrects the remaining duplicated climate setup menus after beta12 introduced native room hubs. Stable v0.5.1 and earlier beta tags are unchanged.

## Select a room, select its devices, save

Configure → Area settings now offers one **Climate devices** entry instead of separate Climate, Climate PID and Area–Devices entry points. Choose the room and select its physical climate equipment. Saving the list completes the flow immediately: there is no mandatory per-device setup wizard or extra Done step.

The selector groups a native climate endpoint and accessory fan belonging to the same physical product into one choice. The integration stores exact native entity IDs internally and beta12's hierarchy creates one Manager controller device per physical product in that room's hub. Independent native control channels remain separate climate entities on that device. Other-room endpoints and Manager-generated climate entities are excluded. Previously selected endpoints remain selectable when their states are unavailable, provided their native registry identity and room assignment can still be verified.

The room hub retains its general settings and environmental entities. Targets, presets, Automatic/Manual/Off/PID, gains and quiet-operation settings remain on the managed devices where supported. These are control methods and device settings, not additional device-selection workflows.

## Optional commissioning, never implicit permission

The same picker includes an optional **Configure sensors and hardware permissions now** checkbox. Leave it off to save the selection directly. Enable it only to continue to the selected device's feedback-sensor and hardware-specific safety setup. This is not a second inventory or PID menu.

Selecting a new endpoint explicitly leaves its auto-control permission off, even when another device in the room is already commissioned. Reselecting old equipment cannot recover a stale automatic-control grant accidentally. Existing selected and commissioned equipment keeps its prior permission. No physical commands are sent by the picker; existing minimum ON/OFF, manual-override, restart and ownership safeguards remain required.

## One authoritative selection, including previous PID setup

Previously configured supervisory PID devices are included in the visible selection. Deselecting equipment removes it from that room's legacy PID list as well as the native-device inventory, disables an empty PID controller, and revokes the removed endpoint's automatic grant. PID tuning, device preferences and other rooms are preserved. Opening or cancelling optional setup cannot mutate saved nested device settings.

All 38 language catalogs include the new menu label and instructions, including Greek **Κλιματικές συσκευές**. Existing room/device/entity IDs and the air_quality_advisor domain are unchanged.

## Install

In HACS select v0.6.0b13 with beta versions visible, restart Home Assistant, and refresh the integration page. Keep the existing entry. Use Configure → Area settings → Climate devices, choose a room and save its device selection. Open that room's hub for the managed devices and their operating controls.

Publication requires Python 3.13/3.14 regressions, translation reproducibility, frontend tests, HACS, Hassfest, the actual Home Assistant 2026.10 registry migration check and installation ZIP verification. CI does not operate or certify physical HVAC equipment, and this release does not claim live verification on the user's Home Assistant installation.
